messages:
maya: Quick follow-up from the Veridian Health incident postmortem — consolidating remediation items and owners. I sketched timelines below, please ACK and update if any dates look off.

maya: Summary: VPC peering flaps + on-prem connector process race caused isolation of Veridian's Dedicated cluster for ~42m. Root cause: backlog during peering rekey + stale CIDR mapping in connector.

maya: Action items (short):
• OWNER: raj — Fix connector CIDR mismatch detection + add fast-fail if mapping ambiguous. Target: 2026-04-05 (PR + internal canary).
• OWNER: eli — Add VPC peering reconciler healthcheck + alert on >3 peering flips in 15m. Target: 2026-03-31 (monitoring + pager rule).
• OWNER: samir — On-prem installer: make connector upgrade idempotent and add preflight check for CIDR overlaps. Target: 2026-04-12 (release v0.9.3).
• OWNER: carla — Postmortem doc + customer comms draft for Veridian. Target: 2026-03-28 (send to CS).
• OWNER: maya — Add runbook step for isolation triage (root cause checklist + quick rollback). Target: 2026-03-30.

raj: ACK — I can take CIDR detection. I'll open RFC and link the design. I want to discuss whether we just reject ambiguous maps or attempt auto-merge.

eli: ACK — I'll add the alert. Proposal: a rolling counter metric `peering.reconciles.count` and an alert threshold of 3 in 15m with severity P2. Thoughts?

samir: ACK. The idempotent installer change is straightforward. We should gate it behind a feature-flag for Veridian initially. Also will add a `--dry-run` preflight CLI.

carla: ACK. I'll draft the customer note and include mitigation steps we performed + timeline. Will ask legal for phrasing.

maya: Raj — prefer reject + require explicit admin override for now. Avoid auto-merge for safety. We'll revisit after canary.

raj: Sounds good. I'll spec the admin override UX (CLI + Console button).

eli: Alerting note: I'll add a runbook link in the alert to the new triage doc. Can we standardize the runbook ID? maya: use runbooks/isolations/veridian-vpc-peering-v1

incident-bot: Incident #2026-03-17-VERIDIAN updated: remediation checklist created by maya.

samir: Quick question — for on-prem we rely on customers' routing tables. Should we add a scheduler to re-verify CIDR mappings daily? That might catch drifts.

maya: Yes, add a daily reconciliation job flagged for Dedicated private installs. Low QPS, can run at 03:00 UTC. Include telemetry events for mismatches.

raj: Will include telemetry: `connector.cidr_mismatch` with fields `expected`, `seen`, `detected_at`, `action_taken`.

eli: For the alert, set PagerDuty to infra-oncall for the first 3 flips, escalate to Eng Platform on 5 flips.

carla: I'll prepare a short timeline + customer-facing FAQs: what happened, how we fixed it, what we're changing. Target to ship to CS by 2026-03-28 EOD.

maya: Thanks team. I'll create a shared board (asana/jira) and assign these items. Please add your PRs to the ticket and ping me when ready for canary.

eli: FYI I'll also add a synthetic check in prod that simulates small peering churn to validate reconciler stability in the staging lane.

samir: Noted. I'll coordinate with Veridian ops for a maintenance window for v0.9.3 if needed.

maya: Final: weekly check-ins until all items closed. First sync: 2026-03-24 10:00 PT. If anyone can't make it, leave updates in the ticket.

raj: Adding RFC link in thread when created.

carla: Drafted comms will include a scheduled follow-up once the changes are in canary.

incident-bot: Reminder: Postmortem follow-up sync scheduled 2026-03-24 17:00 UTC.
